name: search-keyword-blocker
description: Chromium Search Keyword Blocker Extension (Manifest V3)

scripts.package: powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path dist | Out-Null; Compress-Archive -Path @('manifest.json','assets','background','content','core','options','pages','popup','storage') -DestinationPath ('dist/search-keyword-blocker-v' + (Get-Content package.json | ConvertFrom-Json).version + '.zip') -Force"
